facts.text: Edward Weston co-founded the Weston Electric Light Company in Newark, New Jersey, which won the contract to illuminate the Brooklyn Bridge.

Weston founded the Weston Electrical Instrument Corporation in 1888. Its innovations included the Weston standard cell, the first accurate portable voltmeters and ammeters, and the first portable light meter.
facts.sourceNote: New Jersey Historical Society: Weston Instruments Collection

facts.text: Edward Weston helped lay the foundation for the Newark Technical School, which became NJIT.
